meaning.en: The definition of splenetic is relating to the spleen, or spiteful, irritable or bad tempered.
meaning.vi: Định nghĩa về lách từ là liên quan đến lá lách, hay cay cú, cáu kỉnh hoặc nóng tính.

sentences.en: His splenetic temper and her volatility culminated in an open rupture in May 1814.

sentences.en: It was supposed in olden times to be the seat of ill-humour and melancholy, whence such phrases as "to have the spleen," to be out of temper, sulky, morose, "splenetic."
